tools.name: search_songs
tools.description: Finds maimai DX songs by title, alias, nickname, romanization or artist, best match first, with the level and internal level (譜面定数) of each chart. Use it to get the song ID of a song the user names.

tools.name: get_sheet
tools.description: Details of a maimai DX song and its charts (譜面): level, internal level (譜面定数) now and in past versions, note counts, note designer, release date, servers and community tags. Filter by type, difficulty and server.

tools.name: list_recent_songs
tools.description: Lists the maimai DX songs and charts released recently, by release date, newest first: on each date the new songs, and the new charts added to songs released before, with the level and internal level (譜面定数) of each chart. Use it for "what is new" questions. Release dates are those of Japan.

tools.name: calculate_rating
tools.description: The rating a maimai DX chart gives for an achievement, the achievement a rating needs, and the rating of each rank (S to SSS+). Give a chart (looked up with its current internal level) or an internal level. Achievements are integers in 1/10000 of a percent: 100.7543% is 1007543.

tools.name: calculate_best50
tools.description: A maimai DX player's rating from their scores: the new 15 (b15) and old 35 (b35), with each chart's rating, and the scores whose next rank would raise the rating most. Achievements are integers in 1/10000 of a percent: 100.7543% is 1007543.
